text: six methods interchangeable — best different class integrand. short decision table: hcubature uses h-adaptive Genz–Malik subdivision; refines integration region integrand varies . pcubature increases polynomial degree tensor Clenshaw–Curtis rule fixed domain; can efficient smooth integrands brittle features localized (see robustness section ). Cuba’s cuhre h-adaptive like hcubature denser base rule, makes substantially robust non-smooth integrands — cost function evaluations per subregion. Monte Carlo methods (vegas, suave, divonne) scale better deterministic methods high dimensions return probabilistic error estimates rather deterministic bounds. genuine doubt, run integrand cubintegrate two different methods check agree.

title: Get started with cubature
text: default error estimator hcubature uses single “null rule” difference degree-7 Genz–Malik rule embedded degree-5 companion region. smooth integrands reliable cheap. integrands localized support — thin hinge, near-step sigmoid, narrow Gaussian inside oversized bounding box — can fail particular way: rule’s sample points miss integrand’s support entirely, sample values zero, rule estimate zero zero estimated error, algorithm confidently reports “converged” completely wrong answer. distinct ordinary numerical error — algorithm internally consistent; just never evaluated function point ’s nonzero. pcubature can fail way Clenshaw–Curtis tensor grid also fixed sample geometry. small reproducible example: hinge-squared times steep logistic times standard Gaussian [-10, 10]². default settings hcubature returns exactly 0 (returnCode = 0, .e. silent “success”), true integral 0.21:
code: f <- function(x) {   t1 <- -3.5862; t2 <- -9.3801   beta0 <- 9.5;  gamma0 <- 19 * sqrt(0.75)   (max(t1 + t2 * x[1] - x[2], 0))^2 *     plogis(beta0 + gamma0 * x[1]) *     dnorm(x[1]) * dnorm(x[2]) } ## Default: silently wrong hcubature(f, c(-10, -10), c(10, 10))$integral #> [1] 0 ## robust = TRUE: correct hcubature(f, c(-10, -10), c(10, 10), robust = TRUE)$integral #> [1] ~0.21 ## cuhre: also correct cubintegrate(f, c(-10, -10), c(10, 10), method = "cuhre")$integral #> [1] ~0.21

title: Vectorization benchmarks
text: vignette assumes ’ve already read Get started vignette now specific performance question: worth vectorizing R integrand? cubature exposes two calling conventions underlying C routine: Scalar interface (default) — R function receives one point time returns one scalar (length-fDim vector). Vectorized interface (opt-, vectorInterface = TRUE hcubature/pcubature nVec > 1 Cuba methods) — R function receives matrix points returns matrix values, amortizing R’s per-call overhead many integrand evaluations . vectorized interface almost always wins non-trivial problems, sometimes factor 10–50×, dominant cost R’s function-call overhead rather arithmetic inside integrand. speedup depends specific integrand, method pick, dimension. vignette runs ten representative integrands every combination reports timings, can make informed decision rather guess.

title: cubature 2.2.0
text: New robust = TRUE argument hcubature(), pcubature(), cubintegrate(), opting conservative error estimation non-smooth localized integrands. Default behavior unchanged; see Get Started vignette details limitations. Breaking change: hcubature() pcubature() now return returnCode = 2 (CUBATURE_NOT_CONVERGED) emit warning maxEval exhausted without reaching requested tolerance. Previously cases silently returned returnCode = 0. New C-header constants CUBATURE_SUCCESS, CUBATURE_FAILURE, CUBATURE_NOT_CONVERGED exported. Vignettes reorganized: cubature.Rmd now gentle “Get started” introduction covering cubintegrate() robust path; benchmark content moved new vectorization.Rmd vignette. version2.Rmd notes retired. New hex sticker (man/figures/logo.png) pkgdown theme. Breaking change: Removed deprecated doChecking parameter hcubature() pcubature() (ignored since v2.0). Fixed default_args() typo (sauve → suave) cubintegrate() doc typo (forcCuba → Cuba). Harmonized default absError hcubature pcubature (now .Machine$double.eps * 10^2). Updated example URLs ab-initio.mit.edu GitHub. Examples changed \dontrun{} \donttest{} quick examples run package checks. Added Windows CI test matrix. Build-system fix: .ts timestamp files now depend C sources, edits trigger rebuilds correctly. Added comprehensive test suite covering input validation, error handling, boundary conditions, method consistency, regression known reference values.
